assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The payer letter states the denial was because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The clinical indication note documents the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The documentation is submitted as supporting clinical documentation justifying the medical necessity of the service
